Old Root Guardian (CV 52)

An ancient living tree with a broad trunk, heavy root limbs and a crown large enough to shelter birds. It is a guardian of a particular grove, capable of patience as well as immense force.

Attributes: Brawn +2; Fortitude +2; Agility -1; Guile +0; Knowledge +1; Reason +2

HP: 40 · Speed: 4 · Size: 3 (3x3 squares) · Armor DR: 2

Evasion: 1 Boon · Threat: 1 Bane · Stability: 2

Weaknesses: None\ Resistances: Physical (2)\ Immunities: Bleeding; Asleep

Actions

Damage and effects are Weak / Standard / Strong player defense. Each slash separates one complete outcome. All attacks use the printed Threat unless stated otherwise.

Details

Branch sweep

A great limb scythes across the ground, forcing everyone nearby to move.

Target: Up to two creatures within 3 squares. Player defense: Agility. Damage type: physical.

Weak defense: Push each 4. Standard defense: Push each 2.

Root snare

Roots punch through the ground and lace together around the trespassers’ legs.

Target: 5 connected visible ground squares within 6. Player defense: Agility. Damage type: None.

Weak defense: Difficult terrain until next turn; Slowed 2. Standard defense: Difficult terrain until next turn; Slowed 1. Strong defense: Difficult terrain until next turn.

Spell: Provokes when cast beside an enemy.

Limit: Grounded creatures only. Terrain lasts until the start of this creature’s next turn; conditions decay normally. No entry damage or repeated attack.

Weave the Roots

Roots braid themselves into firm footholds across the treacherous ground.

Choose up to 3 connected difficult-terrain ground squares within 3 squares; they count as normal terrain until its next turn. Requires soil or living vegetation; cannot bridge empty space or bypass occupied squares.

General details

Basic Melee: One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses the printed Threat. No specialty riders.

Defend: Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until the start of its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules. Repeated Defend does not stack.

Opportunity Attack: Basic Melee against the provoking creature. Spends its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if the creature remains capable.

Heavy Frame — Passive: Stability 2; an explicit creature trait, not a bonus from size.

Healing: Living: ordinary HP healing applies.

Senses: Ordinary sight and hearing.

Signs: Boundary stones are gently but repeatedly pushed back into place.

Purpose: Keep the oldest grove alive.

Tactics and retreat: Sweep intruders away from saplings and raise roots across a destructive approach.

Counterplay and conversation: End the logging or fire; its anger follows deeds, not the ancestry of those before it.

Habitat: Ancient forest · Communication: Common and old woodland speech

Loot: A granted branch, safe shelter, or directions to a forgotten shrine.

Summoning: Ineligible.

Design notes — not needed during play

CV worksheet

Difficulty rationale: A slow or broad exposed body gives the attacker a Boon. Its dangerous attack imposes defense Banes.

Reference damage: 4/6/9

Reference type: physical

Utility factor: 1.5

Action review (#1279): U 1.45 → 1.5: Maneuver allowance +0.05, Reaction allowance +0. These are provisional judgments for the changed capabilities, counting the largest increment in each category rather than adding every alternative. Reactions compete for one budget; no measured balance claim.
